latest.title: Global recovery of Lorentzian principal geometry from the hyperbolic Dirichlet-to-Neumann map
latest.abstract: We prove that the full Dirichlet-to-Neumann map on a finite time interval globally determines the Lorentzian metric \(\mathbf G_{g,c}=-c(x,t)^2\mathrm{d}t^2+g(x)\) encoded by the principal symbol of the wave operator. The result holds in spatial dimensions \(n\geq3\) for multiplicatively separable wave speeds \(c(x,t)=a(x)b(t)\), provided the accumulated effective time during the experiment exceeds the maximal travel time from the boundary to the interior and back. The data determine both the unknown Riemannian metric \(g(x)\) and the wave speed \(c(x,t)\) throughout the observation cylinder, up to a spatial change of coordinates that fixes the boundary and leaves the measured time unchanged. In particular, the temporal factor \(b\) is not prescribed but is recovered from the same measurements. We also construct several examples demonstrating that the dimensional and visibility conditions for uniqueness are sharp.
latest.workSummary: 论文研究动态 Dirichlet-to-Neumann 数据恢复时空传播速度、度量和势函数，建立时间因果和边界符号到几何系数的恢复链。
latest.breakthrough: Theorem 1.1 在 $n\ge 3$ 下从动态边界数据恢复 g 与 c，模去时间保持空间同胚。
latest.limitations: 依赖正势、光滑紧致流形、观测边界和 $n\ge 3$；恢复结论按自然 gauge 等价。

steps.route: 用能量估计证明给定边界数据存在唯一解，并由有限传播速度限制 Dirichlet-to-Neumann 数据的因果依赖。

steps.route: 计算动态 DN 算子的主符号和高频几何光线，利用边界附近的相位传播时间确定时间函数。

steps.claim: Theorem 1.1 由时钟、度量和势的逐层恢复闭合。
steps.route: 先恢复边界距离/度量，再用内部几何光学和唯一延拓恢复 c，最后比较两组数据得到时间保持空间同胚。
